metric.name: 5. Computational Efficiency (CPU Utilization)
metric.statistic: Mean CPU utilization weighted by observed interval duration, normalized across logical CPUs; sampled P95, peak and failures are retained in evidence.
metric.scope: Owned browser and Python backend process groups while the selected design runs; percent of total logical CPU capacity, not whole-system CPU utilization or a physical ESP32 measurement.

evidence.statistic: process-tree user + system CPU time / interval wall time / logical CPU count * 100
evidence.normalization: 100% means all logical CPU capacity; one fully busy logical CPU is 100 / logical_cpu_count percent
evidence.mean_statistic: interval-duration-weighted mean of normalized CPU percentages
evidence.p95_statistic: P95 of sampled interval percentages (linear interpolation)
evidence.process_lifetime_caveat: New processes are baselined at first sighting; CPU consumed before that sighting or after the last sighting of an exited process is not recoverable. Short-lived processes entirely between samples can be missed.
evidence.graphics_caveat: This headless benchmark uses SwiftShader software rendering, so browser CPU includes software graphics work; remeasure with the final GPU configuration or Electron package.
evidence.aggregation: Pooled successful raw intervals across repeats; mean is weighted by interval duration, while P95 and peak describe sampled intervals; failed samples remain in counts.

source_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted path + NUL + file SHA-256 + newline

production_build.scope: Existing production frontend/dist files, separate from raw-source storage
production_build.source_build_linkage: Unverified: build files are fingerprinted, but a compiler-attested source-to-build mapping is not available. Rebuild immediately before runtime measurements.
